name: Exp_ICHI_OSC
summary: This EA trades based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator combined with an oscillator filter. It enters long positions when price is above the Ichimoku cloud and the oscillator confirms bullish momentum, and enters short positions when price is below the cloud with bearish oscillator confirmation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku)指标结合振荡器过滤进行交易。当价格位于一目云上方且振荡器确认看涨动能时做多，当价格位于一目云下方且振荡器确认看跌动能时做空。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku Kinko Hyo)的趋势判断能力，结合振荡器指标作为入场过滤条件。入场条件方面，做多要求价格位于云层上方且振荡器发出看涨信号，做空要求价格位于云层下方且振荡器发出看跌信号，转换线与基准线的交叉也可能作为辅助入场触发。出场条件包括价格穿越云层、振荡器反转信号以及止损/止盈触发。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA设有止损和止盈参数，但具体的风险控制程度取决于参数设置，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，但在震荡市中可能产生较多假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator's trend identification capability, combined with an oscillator as an entry filter. For entry conditions, long positions require price above the Ichimoku cloud with a bullish oscillator signal, while short positions require price below the cloud with a bearish oscillator confirmation; the Tenkan-Sen/Kijun-Sen crossover may also serve as an auxiliary entry trigger. Exit conditions include price crossing the cloud, oscillator reversal signals, and stop-loss or take-profit hits. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an equity-proportional lot calculation method. Money management features stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but the degree of risk control depends on parameter settings, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a typical trend-following system, but it may generate numerous false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description_en: RSI timeframe, 0 for current chart period

pros: 一目均衡表是多维度趋势判断指标，同时提供支撑阻力、趋势方向和动量信息
结合振荡器过滤减少假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数含义直观便于优化
具有止损止盈设置，基础风险管理完备
pros_en: Ichimoku is a multi-dimensional trend indicator providing support/resistance, trend direction, and momentum information simultaneously
Oscillator filter reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Clear and understandable strategy logic with intuitive parameters for optimization
Built-in stop-loss and take-profit settings provide basic risk management
cons: 趋势跟踪系统在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位调整机制，无法根据市场波动率自适应
振荡器参数固定，在不同市场条件下可能失效
未包含新K线检测机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
cons_en: Trend-following systems are prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism, unable to adapt to market volatility changes
Fixed oscillator parameters may become ineffective under varying market conditions
May lack new bar detection, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar
No spread filter included, which can be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复交易
添加市场波动率自适应的动态仓位管理
增加震荡/趋势市场识别，在震荡市中减少交易频率
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制
improvements_en: Add new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
Add ranging/trending market identification to reduce trade frequency in choppy markets
Include spread filter and trading session restrictions

risk_points: 趋势策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损
缺少新K线检测可能导致重复开仓
固定止损可能无法适应不同波动率环境
risk_points_en: Trend strategy may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lack of new bar detection may cause duplicate position openings
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to different volatility environments
